notes: The clause writes one *I* for `הִנְנִי` and the 1cs perfect together; the accepted alignment gives it to the suffix, since `הִנֵּה` cannot stand without it in English, and leaves the verb its auxiliary and predicate (rules 17, 18, 40).
`גּוֹיִם` takes *of the nations* with the second *the* supplied, no article morpheme standing in the chain (rules 15, 19).
